specs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate a single exquisite Maliu-embroidery-inspired decorative motif for a Chinese craft website. One of a rigorously coordinated collection of THREE base motifs (flower, butterfly, geometric rosette). Square 1254x1254 composition with actual transparent background. Refined flat textile illustration, crisp organized fine diagonal satin stitches and stepped counted-thread details, subtle matte thread texture, almost no shading, NO glossy 3D. Shared limited muted palette: sage green #648d76, jade #366750, coral #ee947e, apricot #efd1a3, warm ivory #faf4e7, tiny matte ochre accents. Keep an airy precise balanced silhouette, elegantly spaced details readable at 220px. Single whole object occupying approximately 78 percent of canvas, centered with equal generous transparent margins. No words, no typography, no frame, no fabric rectangle, no hoop, no drop shadow, no solid background. Design as a tasteful contemporary interpretation of folk geometric embroidery, not a claimed museum reproduction. Subject: one poised eight-petal flower with alternating coral/apricot petals and a small nested diamond jade center, thin ivory stitched geometric accents on petals. A short curving jade stem supports two pairs of gracefully tapered sage leaves. Two tiny coral buds balance lower sides. Delicate symmetry, cleaner simpler outline than a crowded bouquet, an elegant folk flower textile motif.
